title: Flux, Pixels and Planet: End-to-End Workflows for Turning Remote Sensing Data into Insights
description: A free, bilingual (English and Bahasa Indonesia) book on Earth observation in the cloud: from the physics of sensing to Google Earth Engine, machine learning, LiDAR and GeoAI, with real outputs from Indonesian landscapes. Online edition: https://rifkynhsp-byte.github.io/Flux-Pixel-Planet/ . This record archives the source of a released version, including the scripts that produce every figure and table.
